act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In section 413, for the words “or District Magistrate or other Magistrate”, the words “or
text:
70. In section 413, for the words “or District Magistrate or other Magistrate”, the words “or

Chief Judicial Magistrate or other Judicial Magistrate” shall be substituted.
